purpose: A no-face graphics-first scientific-presentation canary proposal centered on the source-supported redshift sweep. This worker packet does not authorize or produce an official candidate.
audience: A scientifically literate general viewer who has not read the manuscript.

audio_contract.future_route_if_Hwao_accepts_and_delegat: Nous managed TTS, voice Alloy, speed 1.18
audio_contract.note: Narration text below is proposed copy only. No TTS, audio file, or narration manifest is produced by this worker pass.

visual_contract.primary_surface: progressive two-panel quantitative redraw from frozen TREND_RESULTS.json
visual_contract.source_pixel_overlay_policy: All explanatory text remains in a right-side or bottom rail; no labels cover model curves, bands, markers, or crossing geometry.
visual_contract.audience_provenance: NebulaMind z-sweep model output (2026-08-04) · 40,000 draws per redshift · model propagation, not a measurement

semantic_definitions.required_escape_fraction: The fraction required by the maintenance-budget model to balance recombinations.
semantic_definitions.proxy_inferred_escape_fraction: A z-independent distribution produced by transporting the same low-redshift O32 and UV-slope proxy calibrations to every grid redshift.
semantic_definitions.Delta: required escape fraction minus proxy-inferred escape fraction
semantic_definitions.median_crossing_z_m: The redshift where the median of Delta crosses zero: 6.328.
semantic_definitions.closure_crossing_z_c: The redshift where the 16th percentile of Delta crosses zero and the 16-84% interval stops spanning zero: 8.045 in the fiducial model.
semantic_definitions.shortfall_probability: Conditional probability mass with Delta greater than zero under the frozen model anchors; not the probability that a real cosmic shortfall exists.

scenes.narration_proposal: Can galaxies leak enough ionizing light to keep the early universe reionized? This model compares the escape fraction the photon budget requires with a proxy-based value.
scenes.visual_action: Open directly on the scientific question and define escape fraction as the share of ionizing photons that get out of galaxies. Then reveal a small preview of the two-panel sweep. Keep a persistent MODEL PROPAGATION — NO NEW MEASUREMENT status chip.
on_screen_copy: Can galaxies leak enough ionizing light?
escape fraction = share of ionizing photons that get out
Compare required leakage with proxy-based leakage
scenes.allowed_claim: The paper performs a literature-anchored model comparison and makes no new measurement.
scenes.forbidden_implication: Do not imply that the plot points are direct galaxy measurements.

scenes.narration_proposal: The required fraction rises with redshift. The inferred fraction stays fixed because the same low-redshift calibrations are transported to every redshift.
scenes.visual_action: Reveal the top-panel axes first, then the required median and 16-84% band, then the fixed proxy-inferred median and band. Attach definitions to the legend, not to floating prose cards.
on_screen_copy: proxy-inferred; fixed in redshift by construction
scenes.allowed_claim: The required median increases over the grid while the proxy-inferred distribution is z-independent by construction.
scenes.forbidden_implication: Do not label these median curves as crossing at z=8.045.

scenes.narration_proposal: Delta means required minus inferred. The band shows the model's sixteen-to-eighty-four percent systematic interval. The budget can still balance while that interval spans zero.
scenes.visual_action: Reveal the bottom Delta panel and zero line. Draw the median and 16-84% envelope from the frozen triples. Highlight the lower envelope edge as the closure criterion.
on_screen_copy: the budget can still balance while the interval spans zero
scenes.allowed_claim: The closure criterion is defined by whether the 16-84% Delta interval spans zero.
scenes.forbidden_implication: Do not describe the shaded interval as observational error or statistical confidence on a measurement.

scenes.narration_proposal: At redshift 8.045, the lower edge touches zero. Resampling the model draws gives sixteen-to-eighty-four-percent bounds of 8.030 to 8.059. This is the closure-envelope crossing, not the median crossing.
scenes.visual_action: Zoom the Delta panel. Mark z_c=8.045 exactly where the 16th-percentile edge reaches zero and show a horizontal bootstrap bracket from 8.030 to 8.059. Keep z_m=6.328 as a small separate label only if the median crossing remains visible.
scenes.allowed_claim: The fiducial closure-envelope crossing is z_c=8.045 with the frozen bootstrap bounds.
scenes.forbidden_implication: Do not say the required and inferred median curves first cross at 8.045.

scenes.narration_proposal: The conditional shortfall fraction rises smoothly: 66 percent at redshift 7, 83 percent at 8, and 93 percent at 9.
scenes.visual_action: Highlight the z=7, 8, and 9 grid markers in sequence on the Delta panel. Place each rounded percentage directly beside its keyed marker and retain the conditional-model status chip.
scenes.allowed_claim: The rounded conditional shortfall fractions are 66%, 83%, and 93% at z=7, 8, and 9.
scenes.forbidden_implication: Do not present the numbers without percent signs, redshift keys, or the conditional-model boundary.

scenes.narration_proposal: In a separate model run, removing the JWST-motivated star-formation-rate-density tail makes closure harder. This removes one prior family and moves the crossing earlier, to redshift 7.615.
scenes.visual_action: Add the separate no-SFRD-tail run's 16th-percentile curve as a dotted comparison. Label it as one prior family removed, not a paired-draw counterfactual. Mark its zero crossing at 7.615 and show finite-Monte-Carlo resampling bounds 7.602-7.631.
on_screen_copy: separate model run; one prior family removed
moves earlier → fiducial tail makes closure easier
scenes.allowed_claim: Removing the JWST-motivated SFRD tail strengthens the deficit and moves the closure crossing earlier.
scenes.forbidden_implication: Do not call this a corner where every assumption is set against the result or a full uncertainty envelope over all omitted systematics.

scenes.narration_proposal: But this is a model propagation, not a measurement. The dominant omission is whether low-redshift proxy calibrations apply above redshift 6; other assumptions also remain outside the Monte Carlo.
scenes.visual_action: Retain the plot and add an external status rail with examples of propagated priors, the dominant omitted proxy-transport systematic, and a note that the rail is not a complete outside-model inventory.
on_screen_copy: EXAMPLES PROPAGATED: ξ_ion, clumping, SFRD priors
DOMINANT OMISSION: proxy evolution with redshift
other structural assumptions also remain unpropagated
no survey measurement in this study
scenes.allowed_claim: Proxy transportability is a dominant untested systematic outside the Monte Carlo.
scenes.forbidden_implication: Do not say the shortfall percentages are the probability that a real cosmic shortfall exists.

scenes.narration_proposal: So the result is a conditional number about frozen anchors. Measuring how escape-fraction proxies evolve at high redshift is the next test.
scenes.visual_action: End on a held scientific summary with a small but complete plot, not a URL card. Use four explicit rows: finding, evidence, boundary, next test.
on_screen_copy: FINDING — closure envelope leaves zero at z_c=8.045
EVIDENCE — lower Delta edge crosses zero; finite-MC 16th–84th bounds 8.030–8.059
BOUNDARY — model propagation over frozen low-z anchors; no new measurement
NEXT TEST — measure proxy transport at high redshift
scenes.allowed_claim: The model's closure-envelope crossing is a conditional result and empirical proxy transport is the next test.
scenes.forbidden_implication: Do not replace the scientific summary with branding or claim the result is a fact about the sky.

asset_contract.redraw_policy: Allowed only as an exact deterministic redraw of frozen arrays and crossing fields. No interpolation beyond the frozen crossing values; no invented points, smoothing, or uncertainty.
asset_contract.provenance_role: MODEL OUTPUT — conditional on frozen low-redshift proxy anchors

acceptance_checks: Every scene is plot- or graphic-primary; no presenter or manuscript cover appears.
z_c=8.045 is attached to the 16th-percentile Delta edge crossing zero, not the median required/inferred curves.
z_m=6.328 is not conflated with z_c.
66%, 83%, and 93% are keyed to z=7, 8, and 9.
The no-tail scenario is named exactly and not broadened into all assumptions.
Both crossing bootstrap intervals remain visible where the values are discussed.
No internal repository path is rendered.
Axis titles, material tick labels, legend, bands, markers, and zero line remain readable at 1920x1080.
The model-versus-measurement boundary is persistent and repeated in the closing hold.
Hwao remains the only candidate/shared-tool/TTS writer.
